sv.title: Black Friday-försäljningen sjönk – månaden viktigare
sv.summary: Konsumtionen under årets Black Friday-rea ökar. Men under själva fredagen krymper försäljningen, enligt nya siffror.

en.title: Black Friday sales fell – the month matters more
en.summary: Consumption during this year's Black Friday sale is rising. But on the day itself, sales shrink, according to new figures.
